subject: MAP draft & exec credit approval request — Avery Technologies
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Selina Park <selina@averytech.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@averytech.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today’s discovery

Selina / Marco — thanks for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of fit:
- Primary workload: customer support triage + knowledge base search (multi-region, GDPR-sensitive).
- Expected Q1 production load: ~1.2M tokens/month, peaks during EMEA daytime.
- Must-have: VPC deployment option and SOC2 report (for procurement).

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Security review (Avery): procurement questionnaire, SAML details, SOC2 evidence — target complete 11/17
2) Technical POC (Redwood + Avery): 2-week scoped POC on dedicated pool — start 11/22
3) Contract & commit negotiation: finalize pricing, credits, and commit level — target signature by 12/15
4) Rollout: phased go-live (pilot -> full) — targeted Jan 2027 pilot

Requested from you: confirm the procurement timeline and who on your side will own the questionnaire. I’ll send a MAP draft that lays out owners, deliverables, success criteria, and a recommended pricing/credit ask for exec review.

Attachments: none yet.

Thanks —
Diego
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: None]

From: Selina Park <selina@averytech.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@averytech.com>, Procurement <procurement@averytech.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:41:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today’s discovery

Thanks Diego — that looks right. Procurement is aiming to wrap the questionnaire by 11/18, but I’ll confirm ownership by EOD tomorrow. Two notes from our side:

- We need a clear list of deliverables for the POC (latency targets, dataset controls).
- On pricing: our budget team will push for a committed discount; we prefer a blended commit across regions if possible.

Please send the MAP draft and the pricing scenarios. Also include any SOC2 artifacts you can share upfront.

Best,
Selina
Head of Product Operations
Avery Technologies
[Attachment: none]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Selina Park <selina@averytech.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@averytech.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -0500
Subject: MAP draft + pricing scenarios (for your review)

Selina / Marco — attaching the MAP draft and three pricing scenarios (low commit / mid commit / high commit). Highlights:

MAP_v1 key milestones & owners (excerpt):
- Security review (procurement & security): Avery (Selina) — owner; Redwood (Neha) — provide SOC2 and SAML guide — target 11/17
- POC plan & success criteria: Avery (Marco) — owner; Redwood (Diego + Ben) — deliver POC infra + runbooks — POC window 11/22–12/6
- Commercial agreement: Redwood (Marissa review) — owner for pricing; Avery (Procurement) — owner for contract approval — target 12/15
- Rollout plan: Avery product + Redwood customer success — pilot Jan 2027

Pricing ask for exec review (recommended):
- Recommended commit: 36-month, regional blended commit of $720k ARR equivalent (50% US / 30% EU / 20% APAC).
- Recommended credit: $60k implementation credit applied over first 12 months (to offset POC + SRE integration).
- Alternative: 24-month commit for $520k ARR equivalent with $30k credit.

Dependencies / risks:
- Procurement gating on SOC2 evidence and SAML test account.
- Legal review on data residency clauses for EU workloads.
- Potential delay if procurement insists on onsite security review.

Attachments:
- Avery_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, success criteria)
- pricing_scenarios.pdf (three scenarios with unit economics)
- SAML_SSC_2026.pdf (SAML implementation notes)

Next internal step: I need an exec pricing signoff or an ask to escalate credits/discounts. Marissa & Rishi — can you review the recommended commit and credit ask below and advise whether this requires EDL-level approval or if you can approve?

Thanks —
Diego
[Attachment: Avery_MAP_v1.xlsx; pricing_scenarios.pdf; SAML_SSC_2026.pdf]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0500
Subject: FYI + pricing approval request (Avery Technologies — RDW-DEAL-2026-848)

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding the MAP and pricing scenarios for your review. Short ask: approval to offer $60k implementation credit with a 36-month commit at the blended $720k ARR equivalent. Rationale:
- POC and SRE work will require 3–4 engineer-weeks of dedicated support; implementation credit reduces friction for procurement.
- Avery is multi-region and strategically strong in financial services vertical (referenceable).
- If we don’t provide credit, risk of slipping to Q2 and losing budget window.

Key commercial sensitivity: if we increase credit beyond $60k we should require a higher committed ARR or shorten the credit redemption period.

Recommended signoff options (pick one):
- Option A (preferred): Approve $60k credit + 36-month commit (no additional approvals needed).
- Option B: Approve $30k credit + 24-month commit (can be approved by AM team).
- Option C: Escalate to EDL for >$60k credit or >36-month pricing concessions.

Please reply with the selected option or questions. If you need a one-line summary for execs I can craft a short memo.

Thanks,
Diego
[Attachment: pricing_scenarios.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: FYI + pricing approval request (Avery Technologies — RDW-DEAL-2026-848)

Diego — thanks for the clear ask and the MAP. I’m okay to approve Option A conditionally: approve $60k implementation credit tied to a signed 36-month commit at the recommended blended ARR, with clause that the credit is only redeemable if contract is signed by 12/15/2026. If legal needs any tighter language, loop me in.

If procurement pushes for a shorter redemption window or additional proof of ROI during the POC, ask the customer for a pilot acceptance metric (we put that in the MAP success criteria).

Rishi — if you agree, I’ll mark this as approved and Diego can communicate the terms to Avery.

Marissa
VP, Commercial Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
